segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי: וַהֲלֹא בְּמוּקְדָּשִׁין, הָאוֹמֵר ״רַגְלָהּ שֶׁל זוֹ״ כּוּ׳.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that according to the Rabbis, one cannot substitute non-sacred limbs for whole consecrated animals, but «Rabbi Yosei said» that one can substitute in this manner. He claims: «But isn’t» it so «with regard to sacrificial» animals, that if «one says: The» hind «leg of this» animal is a burnt offering, the entire animal is a burnt offering? The same should apply to substitution.
